behaviour: The tick step hive drain notice runs in group wrapper health on the slow lane every 120 seconds, and past a ledger stop, as the tick controller, which is not a hive member. Each pass walks every indexed hive and, for a hive whose drain flag and newest drain entry both read draining, leaves one fyi item from swarm at the master seat of each swarm with a live agent on the hive, naming the hive, the drain reason and that swarm's agents. A worker pod stop drain, written by the hive member whose own master item send writes nothing, reaches its masters this way. The item id names the drain entry, so a later pass from any swarm's tick, or a drain whose item another sender already left, sends none. A hive whose newest drain entry reads undrained sends none, and a drain whose agents all ended before the next pass sends none. A hive whose notice raises ends that pass of the step, held as the pass exception, so the hives after it in the index wait for a later pass, as in hive sweep.
seam: scripts.tick.steps.host._hive_drain_notice registered as tick step hive drain notice, calling scripts.hive.master_notice.drained for each record of scripts.hive.sweep.indexed; items read through scripts.inbox.store.InboxStore.inbox at master@<slug>
